title: Cross-cutting format conventions (§4.3-4.6) — materialized, hashable (P14)
description: SEED PLACEHOLDER. Materializes the integration_contracts_design §4.3-4.6 cross-cutting canonicalization conventions as explicit const/enum fields so the contract-drift hash (Plan 05, RFC 8785 -> SHA-256) covers convention changes — not only column reorders (PITFALLS P14). Flipping any const here (e.g. bom false->true) MUST bump the drift hash. All values are EXAMPLE placeholders (A4); domain-confirmed values are Out of Scope (CONTRACT-01).

bom.description: §4.3 byte-order-mark presence — stripped/absent (recommended). .NET may emit a BOM; Python then misreads the first column.

newline.description: §4.3 line ending — force LF (no CRLF). .NET default may be CRLF.

culture.description: §4.6 number formatting culture — InvariantCulture forced (.NET ToString is locale-dependent).

float_compare.description: §4 numeric comparison — tolerance-aware float compare (avoid last-digit repr diffs).

row_ordering.description: §4 key/row ordering — deterministic sort before diff (unordered sets must not cause false diffs).

timezone.description: §4.4 timezone/time format — UTC, fixed ISO-8601 string. Guards .NET DateTime.Kind vs Python naive/aware serialization divergence.

null_token.description: §4.3 explicit null-vs-empty token — EXAMPLE placeholder ('' empty string is distinct from this null token). Domain value TBD.

tsv_escape.description: §4.3 TSV escaping of tab/newline-in-value — EXAMPLE agreed rule (backslash-escape). Domain rule TBD.

interval.description: §4 interval half-open convention [start,end) for time/file ranges.
